content:
Three of Kaggriculture's top-5 teams share the exact same opening — down to individual seed counts and hire numbers. It's the current public reference agent, and it puts a hard ceiling on the ELO band at 3,117 – 3,131.

Above that ceiling sit two teams. Neither runs anything public. Their opening signatures don't match any known notebook. And they're the current rank-1 and rank-2 on the leaderboard.

Notebook Link - https://www.kaggle.com/code/revanthtambisetty/two-private-bots-beating-kaggriculture-meta
